0x00208C.en: 「I am Gan Eden... the guardian deity of Earth.」

0x0020EE.en: 「The wish of the ancients... it shaped us.」

0x00212E.en: 「I am Irui... lord of Baral, the Mashiah.」

0x00219C.en: 「Gan Eden's blessing on those in paradise...」

0x00227E.en: 「The paradise of those who fled disaster.../ to protect it...」

0x0022D1.en: 「By Gan Eden's grace,/ this star will truly become the last paradise.」

0x00233C.en: 「You would lead mankind to the sea of stars.../ you must be eliminated.」

0x0023D2.en: 「To the sea of stars.../ there is no need to venture beyond.」

0x002416.en: 「The Chokijin are my servants.../ those who defy me are evil...」

0x002460.en: 「Let me remind you once more,/　who your true master is.」

0x0024B0.en: 「Super Robots of the Four Gods.../　I shall punish you.」

0x002550.en: 「You who share my blood,/　if you will not obey Gan Eden...」

0x0025F8.en: 「The strong-willed gathering here, now,/　is no coincidence.」

0x002657.en: 「Why were so many strong-willed born in this age.../ Consider the reason.」

0x0026C5.en: 「You too inherit the will and power/　of Augustus, and yet...」

0x00276D.en: 「Your power/　will breed only new calamity.」

0x0027C3.en: 「The will of man/　calls fresh calamity upon this world.」

0x002810.en: 「Leave the rest to me, and sleep now...」

0x00285D.en: 「Can you not grasp the wishes/　of the powerless...?」

0x0028BC.en: 「Will you go on with this futile struggle?」

0x002939.en: 「This is the promised land.../　and so is your fate...」

0x002983.en: 「I'll say it again. I alone am God.」

0x0029EE.en: 「The paradise I guard/　is the true haven, and yet...」

0x002A97.en: 「Ibis.../　it seems I must clip your wings.」

0x002AE7.en: 「The sky you should fly in/　lies within paradise, and yet...」

0x002B8A.en: 「Kusuha.../　if you fight on with the RyuKoOh...」

0x002BDD.en: 「KoRyuOh.../　you must be made to pay.」

0x002C2D.en: 「Bullet.../　so you will not obey Gan Eden...」

0x002C80.en: 「Sanger.../　Gan Eden's grace is no curse.」

0x002CD6.en: 「So you will not be my sword,/　Sanger...」

0x002D26.en: 「Arado.../　if you will not change your mind...」

0x002D76.en: 「Seolla.../　I meant to save you too.」

0x002E09.en: 「It was Gan Eden who gave you/　your blood and power.」

0x002E62.en: 「Do you deny your own roots,/　all of you...」

0x002EEF.en: 「You know it, don't you?/　The gulf between man and god...」

0x002F45.en: 「You are Gan Eden's heirs too.../　and yet...」

0x002F98.en: 「I am not your enemy.../　I am God.」

0x002FE5.en: 「Will you not guard paradise with me...?」

0x003022.en: 「Your creed/　is one I cannot allow...」

0x0030B5.en: 「Do you mean to close/　your own road to the future...?」

0x003170.en: 「Your wish and mine should be the same...」

0x003240.en: 「Ibis... so you'll fight me after all.」

0x00331F.en: 「You turn your blade on me, Sanger...」

0x003420.en: 「You must not use your will so...」

0x003460.en: 「Will's power/　should be wielded under Gan Eden.」

0x0034B3.en: 「Even if your wills unite as one...」

0x0034F0.en: 「For now, I'll take your will head on...」

0x003533.en: 「Do you deny the will of Augustus...」

0x003576.en: 「Your wills/　cannot shake me at all.」

0x0035E8.en: 「Doing such a thing brings no salvation.」

0x00365F.en: 「So you'll defy God to the end...?」

0x00373C.en: 「Let me grant you time to think.」

0x003935.en: 「Eternal rest to the garden of Baral.」

0x0039D8.en: 「And joy and peace to the world.」

0x003A09.en: 「Come forth, holy spirit of Gan Eden...」

0x003A62.en: 「The promised land... to guide them there.」
